channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: Florist opens new shop after leaving her 15-year spot at Norwich station
item.description: Nicole Rivett, who closed Flowers Nicole at Norwich Railway Station less than two weeks ago, has taken on a new shop in New Costessey.

item.title: Pub managers leave despite enjoying a successful first year
item.description: The managers of a traditional pub the Norfolk Broads village Brundall have decided to step down after a year at the site.

item.title: City shop on the market after closure due to owner's death
item.description: Hoopers Surplus in Pottergate has closed its doors after its "irreplaceable" owner passed away.

item.title: Man's fury after claims he was sold car 'in poor state' without the promised warranty
item.description: The owner of a business in Warwickshire has hit out against JD Car Sales, in Swainsthorpe, saying he was sold a shoddy car without the promised warranty.

item.title: Road closures in place as £300,000 project nears completion
item.description: The installation of a new puffin, which forms part of a road revamp at the junction of Christchurch Road and Unthank Road in Norwich, could finish early.

item.title: Motoring menace jailed for driving while banned THREE times in a year
item.description: Jerry Salisbury failed to stop for police and drove on the wrong side of the road among 19 offences.

item.title: Major £2.5 million seaside substation upgrade benefits thousands
item.description: A £2.5 million project in Lowestoft has made the electricity network fit for the future for nearly 15,000 residents.

item.title: Iran war makes by-election defeat like an unfunny sideshow for Starmer
item.description: It’s difficult not to feel sorry for Sir Keir Starmer sometimes given the political situation he finds himself in – and this week he appears to be facing real double trouble.

item.title: How snowball fights keep up morale for Norfolk soldiers during winter training
item.description: FREEZE-DRIED food, a sub-zero climate and snowball fights have been testing Norfolk soldiers getting battle-ready in the forests of Estonia.

item.title: Only three homes left on clittfop road as severe erosion hits Norfolk village
item.description: A winter of severe erosion has pushed Hemsby’s frontline further inland, leaving demolished homes, fractured roads and unanswered questions over future funding.
